recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區被不規則、粉紅色的膠原束切割，膠原間夾雜小淋巴球、漿細胞與肥胖的梭形／肌纖維母細胞及小血管；周邊仍保有密集的淋巴組織，無明顯異型大細胞，屬發炎性偽瘤的纖維化發炎區。
features: Irregular, anastomosing bands of eosinophilic collagen expanding the paracortex
Mixed inflammatory infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells between collagen bundles
Plump spindle (fibroblastic/myofibroblastic) cells and small vessels within the fibrotic area
Adjacent preserved lymphoid tissue with dense small lymphocytes and interfollicular sinusoids
No large atypical cells or Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells evident at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section shows the paracortex expanded by irregular, anastomosing bands of eosinophilic collagen. Between the collagen bundles are small lymphocytes, plasma cells, plump spindle cells and small vessels, while adjacent lymphoid parenchyma remains dense and cellular. No atypical large cells, necrosis or granulomas are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with the paracortical fibroinflammatory stage of nodal inflammatory pseudotumor; IgG4/IgG plasma cell counts, ALK and CD30 immunostains are appropriate to exclude mimics.

ddx.vs: IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with obliterative phlebitis and markedly increased IgG4+ plasma cells (>100/HPF, IgG4/IgG >40%), which was not reached in this case.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (nodular sclerosis or lymphocyte-depleted)
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the fibroinflammatory background, which are not identified here.
The EBV-positive inflammatory FDC sarcoma shows scattered atypical spindle cells that are CD21/CD35 positive and EBER positive, unlike the bland spindle cells of reactive pseudotumor.
